text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki meets a junior struggling
with distance aptitude.
Seeing her despondence, 
Fuji Kiseki wishes to show her a 
"miracle."

Moved by those feelings, the Trainer 
finally makes a decision.
Should it be the 
Triple Crown route, or the Mile route...? 
The path Fuji Kiseki should take is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Japan Derby.

Overcoming the hurdle of distance 
aptitude, Fuji Kiseki chose to pursue the 
Classic Triple Crown route.

Her confession regarding her distance 
aptitude shocked the public. Yet, her 
fans' high expectations remained 
unchanged.

To show the younger Umamusume a miracle, 
Fuji Kiseki set her sights on the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby). A daunting 
challenge was about to begin—!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to NHK Mile Cup.

Aiming for the pinnacle,
Fuji Kiseki chose 
to pursue the mile route.

Fuji Kiseki's change in course came as a 
shock to people. However, the fans remain 
just as hopeful and supportive as ever.

To show the younger Umamusume a miracle, 
Fuji Kiseki set her sights on the NHK
Mile 
Cup. A new challenge was about to begin—!
